notes.title: Development update
notes.notes:
Current development is centred around remaking the character and weapon assets to improve quality, there is no set date for this to be out as I am still working solo, but improvements are being made.

Once assets have been remade and replaced then I'll begin work on new features an mechanics.



There are currently no plans to implement any kind of AI or bot controlled opponents to the game.
